description: GC profile, codon usage deviation, and direct-repeat/att search for the acrVA1 region of M. bovoculi 58069
code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from collections import Counter
E="https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/"
fa=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"nuccore","id":"CP011374.1","rettype":"fasta","retmode":"text"},timeout=200).text
seq="".join(fa.split("\n")[1:]).upper()
ft=requests.get(E+"efetch.fcgi",params={"db":"nuccore","id":"CP011374.1","rettype":"ft","retmode":"text"},timeout=200).text
recs=[];cur=None
for ln in ft.split("\n"):
    if ln.startswith(">Feature") or not ln.strip(): continue
    p=ln.split("\t")
    if p[0] and re.match(r'^[<>]?\d+$',p[0]):
        s=int(p[0].lstrip("<>")); e=int(p[1].lstrip("<>")) if len(p)>1 and p[1] else s
        t=p[2] if len(p)>2 else ""
        if t: cur={"start":min(s,e),"end":max(s,e),"strand":"+" if s<=e else "-","type":t}; recs.append(cur)
    elif len(p)>=5 and p[3] and cur is not None: cur.setdefault(p[3],p[4])
df=pd.DataFrame(recs)
g=df[df.type=="gene"][["start","end","locus_tag"]].rename(columns={"locus_tag":"lt"})
cds=df[df.type=="CDS"].merge(g,on=["start","end"],how="left")
ACR_S,ACR_E=1623942,1624454
# --- element boundaries: left = after last housekeeping gene lpxD (ends 1616724); right = tRNA-Val end 1672475
EL_S,EL_E=1616725,1672475
L=len(seq); gcall=100*(seq.count("G")+seq.count("C"))/L
gcel=100*(seq[EL_S-1:EL_E].count("G")+seq[EL_S-1:EL_E].count("C"))/(EL_E-EL_S+1)
print(f"genome length {L}; genome GC {gcall:.2f}%; candidate element {EL_S}-{EL_E} ({(EL_E-EL_S+1)/1000:.1f} kb) GC {gcel:.2f}%")

# sliding window GC, 2kb step 500
w,st=2000,500
starts=np.arange(0,L-w,st)
gc=np.array([100*(seq[i:i+w].count("G")+seq[i:i+w].count("C"))/w for i in starts])
mu,sd=gc.mean(),gc.std()
inel=(starts+w/2>=EL_S)&(starts+w/2<=EL_E)
from scipy import stats
t,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(gc[inel],gc[~inel])
print(f"window GC: genome {mu:.2f}+-{sd:.2f}%; element windows n={inel.sum()} mean {gc[inel].mean():.2f}% ; Mann-Whitney U p={p:.2e}")
print(f"element GC z-score vs genome windows: {(gc[inel].mean()-mu)/sd:.2f}")

# --- codon usage: per-CDS codon frequency, chi2 distance to genome-wide mean
def codons(s):
    return [s[i:i+3] for i in range(0,len(s)-2,3)]
def rc(s): return s.translate(str.maketrans("ACGT","TGCA"))[::-1]
cds2=cds.dropna(subset=["lt"]).copy()
cds2["L"]=cds2.end-cds2.start+1
cds2=cds2[(cds2.L%3==0)&(cds2.L>=300)]
cod_list=[]
for _,r in cds2.iterrows():
    s=seq[r.start-1:r.end]
    if r.strand=="-": s=rc(s)
    c=Counter(codons(s)); cod_list.append(c)
allcod=sorted({c for d in cod_list for c in d if set(c)<=set("ACGT")})
Mx=np.array([[d.get(c,0) for c in allcod] for d in cod_list],float)
Mx=Mx/Mx.sum(1,keepdims=True)
ref=Mx.mean(0)
dist=np.sqrt(((Mx-ref)**2).sum(1))
cds2=cds2.assign(cod_dist=dist, gc3=[0]*len(cds2))
el_mask=((cds2.start>=EL_S)&(cds2.end<=EL_E)).values
u,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(dist[el_mask],dist[~el_mask])
print(f"\ncodon-usage Euclidean distance to genome mean: element CDS n={el_mask.sum()} median {np.median(dist[el_mask]):.4f} vs rest n={(~el_mask).sum()} median {np.median(dist[~el_mask]):.4f}; MWU p={pu:.2e}")
acr_d=cds2[(cds2.start==ACR_S)].cod_dist.values
print("acrVA1 codon distance:",np.round(acr_d,4), "percentile in genome:",round(100*(dist<acr_d[0]).mean(),1))

# --- att site search: longest exact repeat between left-boundary window and tRNA-Val window
A=seq[1614000:1620500]; B=seq[1670500:1674500]
best=None
for k in range(60,11,-1):
    sets={}
    for i in range(len(A)-k+1): sets.setdefault(A[i:i+k],[]).append(i)
    found=None
    for j in range(len(B)-k+1):
        if B[j:j+k] in sets: found=(k,sets[B[j:j+k]][0]+1614000+1, j+1670500+1, B[j:j+k]); break
    if found: best=found; break
print(f"\nLongest exact direct repeat between 1,614,000-1,620,500 and 1,670,500-1,674,500: k={best[0]} at {best[1]} and {best[2]}\n  seq={best[3]}")
tRNA=df[(df.type=='tRNA')&(df.start==1672399)]
print("nearest tRNA (tRNA-Val) 1,672,399-1,672,475; integrase AAX09_07730 1,671,248-1,672,252; gap to tRNA = 147 bp")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(2,1,figsize=(13,7),gridspec_kw={"height_ratios":[2,1]})
ax[0].plot(starts/1e6,gc,lw=0.5,color="#4C6EF5")
ax[0].axhline(mu,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1,label=f"genome mean {mu:.1f}%")
ax[0].axvspan(EL_S/1e6,EL_E/1e6,color="#FA5252",alpha=0.25,label="candidate prophage 1.617-1.672 Mb")
ax[0].axvline(ACR_S/1e6,color="black",lw=1.2)
ax[0].annotate("acrVA1",(ACR_S/1e6,56),ha="center",fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_xlabel("position on CP011374.1 (Mb)"); ax[0].set_ylabel("GC % (2 kb window)")
ax[0].set_title("Moraxella bovoculi 58069 chromosome: GC profile and the acrVA1 region")
ax[0].legend(fontsize=8)
sub=(starts>EL_S-60000)&(starts<EL_E+60000)
ax[1].plot(starts[sub]/1e6,gc[sub],lw=1,color="#4C6EF5")
ax[1].axhline(mu,color="grey",ls="--",lw=1)
ax[1].axvspan(EL_S/1e6,EL_E/1e6,color="#FA5252",alpha=0.25)
ax[1].axvline(ACR_S/1e6,color="black",lw=1.2)
for x,lab in [(1623942,"acrVA1"),(1652117,"terminase"),(1634986,"tail"),(1671248,"integrase"),(1672399,"tRNA-Val")]:
    ax[1].annotate(lab,(x/1e6,gc[sub].max()+0.6),rotation=90,fontsize=8,ha="center",va="bottom")
ax[1].set_ylim(gc[sub].min()-1,gc[sub].max()+6)
ax[1].set_xlabel("position (Mb)"); ax[1].set_ylabel("GC %")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
